english.title: Prospective adopter fails to return child placed for adoption consent withdrawn w/i 14 days of receipt of s.32(2) notice
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a prospective adopter who had been given notice by an adoption agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), under section 32(2) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002 to return **(..SPECIFY NAME OR IDENTITY OF CHILD..) to that agency, failed to do so within the period of 14 days beginning with the day on which the notice was given
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32 of the Adoption and Children Act 2002.

english.notes:
(i) This section applies whether or not the child in question is in England and Wales.
(ii) This section does not affect the exercise by any local authority or other person of any power conferred by any enactment, other than section 20(8) of the Children Act 1989 (removal of children from local authority accommodation.
(iii) This section does not prevent the removal of a child who is arrested.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a prospective adopter who had been given notice by an adoption agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), under section 32(2) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002 to return **(..SPECIFY NAME OR IDENTITY OF CHILD..) to that agency, failed to do so within the period of 14 days beginning with the day on which the notice was given.

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding three months and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
